title: Customer replied OUTSIDE 30 days ? reopened and handled as APPEAL | APPR | Controllable (Code 63, late crew boarding / departure procedures) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs | 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks what happens when a customer replies too late to a parked, eligible case. AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late for a controllable reason (Code 63, late flight deck crew boarding and departure procedures). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before the payment step. The agent sends "Decision Rendered � Action Required" and parks the case. There's no reply within 30 days, so the case closes. The customer replies on day 35, and the same case must reopen as an Appeal. It must not be handled as a normal customer response or opened as a new case. The agent upholds the decision as Eligible. Basic Aeroplan is linked, so Cash (CAD 700) and AC Wallet (CAD 840) are both offered. The customer is a Canada resident and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected.

Prerequisites:
PNR PK008: one passenger, Julien Gagnon (Adult, Basic Aeroplan member 9876543210, good standing). One AC domestic leg: AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h, 420 min). Cancellation code: NONE. Arrival delay code: 63 (FT, late crew boarding / departure procedures, controllable). Fallback: FALSE. Travelled, arrived late. No VOL or INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed July 28, 2026 (more than 72 hrs, within 366 days). No duplicate. Not an employee, not an infant. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Park start Aug 1, 2026. 30-day window ends Aug 31, 2026. Customer reply Sep 5, 2026 (day 35). Test access: agent and lead in Claims Dashboard, with the ability to trigger or simulate the 30-day expiry in UAT. Payment: Interac only, email only.
